title: The Pelican Bursar's Cut
story: In the stilt-village of Lowlantern, the whole season's pearl trade — 480 ember coins — was scooped up in one gulp by Wandrelle the Pelican Bursar, a giant pelican with a ledger painted on her beak pouch. She insists that 35% of any purse she carries is a lawful "carrying fee." Mr 6 climbs the ladder-dock and offers to do her arithmetic for her, politely, in front of everybody.
question: If Wandrelle keeps 35% of the 480 ember coins and the rest is shared equally among the 12 stilt-houses, how many ember coins does each house receive?
solution: Wandrelle keeps 35%, so the village keeps 100% - 35% = 65%: 480 x 0.65 = 312 coins.
praise: Reaching for the percent was the right first move — the leftover 65% still had to be split among the 12 houses.
hint: First figure out how many coins are left for the village AFTER her fee, then split that amount.
victory: Mr 6 read the sums aloud so clearly that Wandrelle blushed pink to her beak, handed back a bonus pearl "for the accounting," and flapped off to find an honest job weighing fish.
imagePrompt: A huge ledger-marked pelican perched on a stilt-village dock at sunset, coins spilling from her beak pouch, while a small numeral-6 knight with a blue cape chalks percentages on a plank for cheering fisherfolk.
